entries.serves: Interpretar la exposición gamma (GEX) actual de un símbolo con datos de GaleCore.
example_requests: Analizá el GEX actual de SPY.
controls: Numbers only in quantitative_claims, each equal to a GaleCore fact with its unit
No digits in observations or implications
Regime by the sign of net_gex; near_zero always rejected
Evidence paths resolve (entailment is not checked)

entries.serves: Registrar el régimen diario de un símbolo (GEX, skew 25Δ, VIX/VVIX) y evaluarlo después.
example_requests: Analizá el régimen de hoy de SPY y guardalo.
¿Qué dijimos del régimen la semana pasada y qué pasó?
flow: accept --record --prompt "<pedido del usuario>" < {run_id, interpretation, host_provider, host_model}
controls: The GEX controls, plus tail_pricing equal to GaleCore's put_skew_level_ok
Record entry hashed at acceptance; outcomes and reviews appended, never rewritten
The review verdict is the owner's (F-6)
Daily records only after the cash session (F-2)

entries.serves: Investigar una idea con los antecedentes disponibles (registros, investigaciones previas, archivos locales), producir una hipótesis y un plan de prueba con fuentes y limitaciones, conservarlos y retomarlos en otra sesión.
example_requests: Investigá si el 0DTE vencido distorsiona el GEX post-cierre y cómo lo probaríamos.
Retomá la investigación sobre el GEX post-cierre.
flow: research save --slug <slug> --prompt "<pedido del usuario>" < {content, host_provider, host_model}
research revise --id <id> --reason continuation|correction|result --note "<qué cambia>" --prompt "<pedido>" < {content, host_provider, host_model}
controls: Every antecedent and source resolves to an intact knowledge item or an existing workspace file
Every antecedent says how it affects the hypothesis or the plan
A statement marked as fact cites at least one source
Open or test_planned work lists its next steps; a test plan needs its hypothesis
Revisions are append-only and hashed; a changed earlier revision is INTEGRITY_FAILED
Not checked - whether the reasoning is right, or whether a fact's source supports it
